_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil base rate (96% of 12h windows moved <2 points over 7 days) makes HOLD the statistically honest default — a directional UP call requires seeing the breaker (MVRV Z-score rising toward 30 with F&G sub-35), which has not yet triggered.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls UP with low conviction and strict confirmation gates; narrative implies UP with higher confidence and fewer conditions; the judge sides with the coil base rate over both directional leans.
next_move.confirmed_if: MVRV Z-score rises above 30 with Fear & Greed remaining below 35 and BTC holds above $62K
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC breaks below $60K with funding spiking above 0.015% and stablecoin growth dropping below 40
